title: Assurance activity (proposal)
description: Framework proposal; no open schema exists for an act of assurance. Attributes from Table 19.1 and components C6.2, C0.3 [18] [4].

id.description: Persistent identifier, unique within the organization.

catalog_version.description: Catalog version the record was created under (C1.1; seventh principle: currency is a field).

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record validates against.

version.description: Version of this record; rises on every change (nothing changes silently).

owner.description: Named owner (a person or role, never a function alone).

provider.description: Who performed the assurance, by name.

activity.description: What was done: self-assessment, test, audit, review.

reliance.description: Reliance assessment on another line's work (IIA standard 9.5) [18].

twelve_month_safeguard.description: True if the provider did not design the control within the last twelve months (C0.3).
